newsitem.title: USA: Hines, TCW, Dean Witter close emerging mkts fund.
newsitem.headline: Hines, TCW, Dean Witter close emerging mkts fund.

text.p: Hines Interests Limited Partnership, The TCW Group Inc and Dean Witter Realty Inc said on Monday that the Emerging Markets Real Estate fund would be closed to new investors at $410 million.
The fund, which would invest in the development of Class A real estate in emerging markets, exceeded its initial capital-raising target of $250 million, they said.
The companies said they expected to develop projects on behalf of several of Hines' existing clients, as well as other U.S., European and Asian multinational corporations.
